name: 4ga Boards
description: 4ga Boards is a self-hosted kanban board for realtime project management, originally a fork of Planka. Boards hold lists, cards and task lists with Markdown, labels, due dates, timers, comments and attachments, and users can sign in with Google, GitHub, Microsoft or OIDC.

notes.text: The admin password is DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD in /opt/4gaboards_data/.env. Log in as admin and change it under Settings.
Registration is open: anyone who reaches the port can create an account. Turn off User Registration in Settings > Instance Settings if that is not wanted.
Realtime updates only work from the address in BASE_URL (/opt/4gaboards_data/.env). Behind a reverse proxy or domain, change it, add TRUST_PROXY=1 and run systemctl restart 4gaboards.
